description:
An exciting PRN opportunity is available for a dedicated Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) in Inverness, FL. Join a premier health and rehabilitation center committed to providing exceptional patient care. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, reflecting the value we place on your expertise.

We are also pleased to offer a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to qualified candidates, demonstrating our commitment to attracting top talent. As a PRN SLP, you will have the flexibility to make a significant impact on patients' lives while managing your own schedule. If you are passionate about helping individuals regain their communication and swallowing abilities, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Experience in a health and rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00 per hour, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:

requirements: Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)

Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary therapy team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
